policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a non-binding regulatory guidance document (version 2.0, revised April 2025) issued jointly by the Digital Platform Government Committee and NIA for the South Korean public sector. It covers hyperscale/generative AI (초거대 AI/LLM) adoption across central ministries, local governments, and public institutions. Key obligations are framed as principles and checklists rather than legally enforceable mandates. Data security classification (C/S/O) and CSAP cloud certification requirements reference existing binding law (클라우드컴퓨팅법, 정보공개법, N2SF). AI ethics compliance references the MSIT AI Ethics Guidelines (2020). The document does not specify civil or criminal penalties; enforcement relies on existing procurement and cloud security regulatory frameworks. Performance management framework (Part 4) provides KPI pools for AI project lifecycle evaluation.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around enabling public sector adoption of hyperscale AI to modernize government services, improve administrative efficiency, and solve social problems. The dominant rationale throughout is operational enablement: providing procedures, frameworks, and guidelines to help public agencies successfully introduce and use AI technology. Safety and rights protections (data security, AI ethics, personal information) appear as secondary compliance requirements within an overarching innovation-enablement narrative, not as the primary driver. National security concerns appear narrowly in data classification and network security contexts.

evidence_spans.quote: 본 가이드라인은 중앙부처·지자체·공공기관·국회·법원 등 전 공공부문에서 디지털플랫폼정부의 철학과 원칙에 따라 초거대 AI를 도입·활용하는데 필요한 관련 기준과 절차, 고려 사항을 안내하는 것을 목적으로 함
